cover: Name the belief: once I've learned what's wrong and fixed it, I'll meet my person. Many of us have done years of inner work on that basis.
The crack: your friends who settled down weren't even trying, and they didn't know more than you.
The radio analogy: you're reading the radio manual instead of changing the station. You only pick up the station you're tuned to.
The real cause: it's the emotional state you carry around love, not life in general. You can feel free at work and still feel worry or frustration the moment you think about being with someone.
Why it's not wrong: all that learning is not wrong, it's just not what attracts the right person. The right emotional state does.
Land on: You don't need to know more. You need to feel differently about love, and that's something you can practise every day.

CTA: If you're ready to change the station instead of reading another manual, comment 'ATTRACTION' below and I'll send you the meditation and access to the community, free for 7 days. Or DM me 'ATTRACTION' if you'd rather keep it private.
ideaqueue.say: Everyone tells you to learn more about love first, and your friends who did none of that are the ones who settled down.
